# Kubo

> Kubo connects US companies with Colombian professionals for remote work. Companies browse profiles, interview, and hire through Kubo. Kubo employs the person in Colombia: contract, health insurance, workers’ compensation, retirement contributions, and payroll.

## Product

- App: https://app.kubolab.io/
- Companies: register, review approved candidates, interview, and send offers.
- Talent: upload a CV, salary range, and English level; receive interviews and offers.
- Candidate contact details stay private. Conversation happens inside Kubo.
